description: The end-to-end harness window (src/selftest.rs). It grants the same storage commands as the shipped window plus `allow-selftest-report`, which prints the transcript and ends the process. It is deliberately a separate capability from `default` so that nothing the shipped window may do depends on test code: the window label it names is created only when BRAGI_SELFTEST_PHASE is set, so in a normal build this grant matches no window at all.
